fix_subject: Fix for the problem identified in [forum:/forumpost/0cd8e058bf|forum post 0cd8e058bf]: When evaluating an multi-index OR, do not push down auxiliary WHERE clause terms that involve subqueries into the OR-subqueries.  Otherwise, the covering-index optimizer might convert table-references into index-references for the particular OR index that is active for the branch in which the subquery subroutine is coded, and those index-references will not work if the subquery subroutine is invoked from a different OR branch that uses a different index.
